completedActions.description: Implement AudioSynthesisSession for background audio synthesis

Architectural refactor: Move callback throttling to AudioSynthesisSession (COMPLETED in T_AZwyuQKWc) — progressCallback now optional, fires on state transitions only; polling via session.value for smooth progress
Design: Review SuttaCardView play button structure (toolbar at line 135-149) and AudioSynthesisSession state machine (SynthesisState enum at line 4-10, SessionSnapshot at line 13-23)
I001: Add @State var backgroundSession: AudioSynthesisSession? to SuttaCardView (line 33). Actor reference is Sendable and safe in @State.
I002/zGoTlcAC: Implement .contextMenu on play button for long-press menu (lines 157-161). Calls startSynthesis() with 'Background Playback' label.

I003: Create SynthesisProgressModal view (lines 363-522) displaying progress circle, currentStep/totalSteps, estimated time remaining, state messages, and cancel/done button. Polling loop reads session.value at 500ms intervals.
I004: Handle session lifecycle with .onDisappear handlers in both SuttaCardView (lines 316-329) and SynthesisProgressModal (lines 482-487). Both cancel backgroundSession to prevent orphaned tasks.

zIsurcAC: Localize synthesis modal strings in all 7 languages. All UI text uses .localized keys: synthesis.title, synthesis.synthesizing, synthesis.time_remaining, synthesis.complete, synthesis.cancelled, synthesis.error, synthesis.starting, synthesis.cancel, synthesis.done, synthesis.background_playback. Translations added to de, es, fr, lt, pt-PT, ru (English already complete).
T001: Verified end-to-end prefetch — long-press initiates synthesis, modal shows progress updates (currentStep increments), completion updates state. Full synthesis tested.

T002: Verified cancellation and partial synthesis — modal handles both fully cached and mixed cached/uncached segments. EMA estimation (T_AZwzMtyTc) ensures accurate time remaining for partially cached suttas.

C001: Removed prepareSuttaAudio() from SuttaPlayer. Method was deprecated with @available(*, deprecated). Removed 4 associated tests from SuttaPlayerTests (prepareSuttaAudioQueuesAllSegments, prepareSuttaAudioDoesNotTriggerPlayback, prepareSuttaAudioProgressCallback, prepareSuttaAudioErrorsWhenDocumentNotFound).
